main_text.l: sanctificatorum salus. Psal. 84. 8. Ibunt de virtute ad
virtutem, donec conspiciatur quisque eorum ante Deum
in Tzijone. Phil. 4, 14.
XIX. Pro praxi; 1. Ne adversus praeclarum il-
lud Dei & Christi nos conservantis beneficium profa-
na ingratitudine peccemus: 2 Cor. 7, 1. Sed serio
expendamus, quae poenae maneant sanctimoniae ex-
pertes: Hebr. XII, 14, 16. Matth. VII, 23. XXV, 41.
& quomodo ipsi sanctificati, ubi officia sua negli-
gunt, & in graviora peccata labuntur, saepius affli-
gantur graviter; tum animo, variis terroribus: Psal.
6, 4. tum corpore, morbis & cruciatibus: Levit. 26. 16. Psal. 6, 2, 3. XXXVIII,
2, 3, 4. 1 Cor. XI, 31, 32. tum denique bonis externis, per eorum jacturam:
Levit. XXVI, 16, 17. Hos. 2, 8. Ista nos a defectione
absterreant, & in veram sanctitatis viam redigant:
2. Sincerum esto, ac perpetuum, sub hac Dei &
Servatoris nostri gratia, studium Ipsi parendi ac pla-
cendi: Rom. 12, 1. 2 Thess. 2, 13. Sic methodum sa-
lutis obtinendae, Decreto Dei constitutam, Euan-
gelio nobis revelatam, variisque Promissionibus conf-
irmatam, observemus sedulo & constanter: Rom.
VIII, 28. -. 1 Tim. IV, 7. -10. Hebr. X, 35, 36. Matth.
XXIV, 13.
3. Agnoscamus ordinariam illam methodum salu-
tis applicandae: & necessitatem atque insignem utili-
tatem incrementi spiritualis: Eph. 4, 16. Psal. 84, 8.
Phil. 3, 14.
4. Exploremus nos ipsos quoufque modo perveneri-
mus; & quae sint nostrae vires spirituales: Zeph. 2, 1.
1 Cor. XI, 28. Profectui & corroborationi studeamus
sedulo: Iof. I, 6, 7, 9. adhibitis potissimum mediis,
quae indicata sunt sup. th. 17.
CAP.

page.notes: Catchword-like line "CAP." at lower right is treated as the closing word of the page. Some words in the scan are blurred; the Greek in "Tzijone" (Sion) is transliterated as printed in the scan and may be doubtful. Right-hand page text is not present; only one printed page.
